'
# ============================================================
# HEATMAP 1 – PEARSON CORRELATION
# COMPACT LAYOUT | DARK TEAL GRADIENT
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. COLORS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
INK = ''#173F3D''
BG = ''#F4F8F7''

CMAP_TEAL = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    ''teal_gradient'',
    [''#B2E4DC'', ''#55BDB0'', ''#21998D'', ''#0F766E'', ''#07534F'']
)

RAW_COLS = [
    ''TongTaiSan'',
    ''TongDoanhThu'',
    ''TongNoPhaiTra'',
    ''EBITDA'',
    ''LoiNhuanRong''
]

RAW_LABELS = [
    ''Tổng tài sản'',
    ''Tổng doanh thu'',
    ''Tổng nợ phải trả'',
    ''EBITDA'',
    ''Lợi nhuận ròng''
]

X_LABELS = [
    ''Tài sản'',
    ''Doanh thu'',
    ''Nợ phải trả'',
    ''EBITDA'',
    ''LN ròng''
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CALCULATE PEARSON CORRELATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------
missing_cols = [c for c in RAW_COLS if c not in dataset.columns]

if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f''Thiếu các cột: {missing_cols}'')

cm = dataset[RAW_COLS].corr(method=''pearson'')
n = len(RAW_COLS)

mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(cm.values, dtype=bool))
data = np.ma.array(cm.values, mask=mask)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. FIGURE – REDUCE OUTER MARGINS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6), facecolor=BG)

# Heatmap: giảm lề trái, tăng diện tích hiển thị
ax = fig.add_axes([0.15, 0.13, 0.59, 0.75])
ax.set_facecolor(BG)

im = ax.imshow(
    data,
    cmap=CMAP_TEAL,
    vmin=-1,
    vmax=1,
    aspect=''equal'',
    interpolation=''nearest''
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. CORRELATION VALUES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i):
        v = cm.values[i, j]

        rgba = CMAP_TEAL((v + 1) / 2)
        luminance = (
            0.299 * rgba[0]
            + 0.587 * rgba[1]
            + 0.114 * rgba[2]
        )

        ax.text(
            j, i,
            f''{v:.2f}''.replace(''.'', '',''),
            ha=''center'',
            va=''center'',
            fontsize=12,
            fontweight=''bold'',
            color=''white'' if luminance < 0.58 else INK
        )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. AXIS LABELS – CENTERED ON EACH CELL
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(n))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    X_LABELS,
    fontsize=10,
    color=INK,
    rotation=0,
    ha=''center''
)

ax.set_yticks(np.arange(n))
ax.set_yticklabels(
    RAW_LABELS,
    fontsize=10,
    color=INK,
    rotation=0,
    ha=''right''
)

ax.set_xlim(-0.5, n - 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(n - 0.5, -0.5)

ax.tick_params(axis=''x'', length=0, pad=6)
ax.tick_params(axis=''y'', length=0, pad=6)

for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. COLORBAR – CLOSER TO THE HEATMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cax = fig.add_axes([0.83, 0.27, 0.018, 0.52])

cb = fig.colorbar(im, cax=cax)
cb.outline.set_visible(False)

cb.set_label(
    ''Hệ số tương quan'',
    fontsize=9,
    color=INK,
    labelpad=5
)

cb.ax.tick_params(
    labelsize=9,
    colors=INK,
    length=2,
    pad=2
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. MAIN TITLE – FONT SIZE 20
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fig.suptitle(
    ''Hệ số tương quan chỉ số thô'',
    fontsize=20,
    fontweight=''bold'',
    color=INK,
    y=0.97
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plt.show()
'
'Hệ số tương quan chỉ số thô'
'''Segoe UI Bold'', wf_segoe-ui_bold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif'
